description: Reports to Neblla's team a failure of NEBLLA itself (a tool, a page, the SDK), never of the developer's own code. Show the developer what will be sent and send only if they agree; no personal data or keys. Returns similar public reports to vote for instead. 20 a day, shared with neblla_suggest_feature. More: neblla_get_llms tools/report_bug

errorId.description: The errorId of a failed Neblla tool answer.

happened.description: What happened instead, and what was expected.

tool.description: The Neblla tool involved, e.g. neblla_update_app.
